purpose: Resolve the sealed V57 numerical failure without changing its train-only population, thresholds, region definitions, component ranking, or scientific classification branches. Reproduce the original V56 gate in its original unranked 64-point Gauss-Hermite summation order, while replacing discontinuous threshold-binned Gauss-Hermite tail integration with smooth fixed Gauss-Legendre integration over exact analytic component-normal CDF intervals.

population_and_partition.probe: the identical deterministic 4096-voxel probe per object
population_and_partition.query_stratum: the identical domainwise q99.9-and-above query-backbone stratum
population_and_partition.thresholds: the identical V57 q99.999 anchor plus the 16 exact V56 grid thresholds
population_and_partition.bins: the identical 18 strict-exceedance bins and below-grid, inside-grid, and beyond-grid regions
population_and_partition.component_ranking: the identical per-voxel increasing latent-location ranking

integration.exact_V56_reproduction: For every selected probe voxel, retain the original unsorted five-component order and call the exact V56 64-point Gauss-Hermite physical-moment implementation before summing components and probe voxels.
integration.threshold_CDF_boundaries: Map every physical output threshold through the bounded-logit inverse and each component Gaussian CDF. Add exact probability endpoints zero and one to form 18 mutually exclusive component-normal probability intervals.
integration.primary_tail_rule: 128-point Gauss-Legendre integration in the uniform component-normal CDF coordinate independently inside every exact probability interval; the integrand contains no threshold indicator.
integration.control_tail_rule: 64-point Gauss-Legendre integration over the identical exact probability intervals.
integration.analytic_probability: Exact interval width multiplied by mixture mass; no quadrature is used for bin or survival probabilities.
integration.component_moment: Mixture-mass-weighted physical delta-squared integral in each interval, aggregated after the per-voxel location ranking.
integration.endpoint_rule: Gauss-Legendre nodes are strictly interior; CDF coordinates are evaluated in float64 and clamped only to the adjacent representable values inside zero and one before inverse-normal evaluation.

numerics.unsupported_threshold_rule: Report predicted probability and moment but do not form truth ratios or use the threshold in probability-versus-amplitude classification.
numerics.failure_action: If any numerical requirement fails, report all measurements but make no scientific mechanism classification and freeze only the minimal further train-only numerical repair.

classification.source: the frozen V57 classification branches, reproduced without alteration

branches.condition: TNG100 beyond-grid positive-excess share is at least 0.5
TNG100 below-grid positive-excess share is at least 0.5

TNG100 inside-grid positive-excess share is at least 0.5 and the supported-grid weighted mean absolute log probability ratio is strictly greater than the weighted mean absolute log conditional-amplitude ratio
TNG100 inside-grid positive-excess share is at least 0.5 and the supported-grid weighted mean absolute log conditional-amplitude ratio is at least the weighted mean absolute log probability ratio
